lines.text: POV: it's three in the morning and you're still refreshing flight prices.
lines.visualPrompt: person in dark room lit by phone screen at night, tired

lines.text: Refresh. Same price. Refresh. Up by ten. Refresh. Down by five.
lines.visualPrompt: finger refreshing phone repeatedly, glowing screen in dark

lines.text: You tell yourself just one more check and then you'll sleep.
lines.visualPrompt: tired person rubbing eyes, phone in hand, late night

lines.text: Or you let Flight Price Watch do the staring for you, all night.
lines.visualPrompt: real Flight Price Watch tracker page screen recording

lines.text: It tracks the price around the clock and pings you when it drops.
lines.visualPrompt: phone notification of price drop, calm bedside table

lines.text: So you can actually sleep. Wild concept, I know.
lines.visualPrompt: person sleeping peacefully, cozy bed, morning light

lines.text: You wake up, the price fell, you book. No three a.m. suffering.
lines.visualPrompt: happy person with morning coffee checking phone, relaxed

lines.text: Stop refreshing at 3am. Let the app watch. Link in bio.
lines.visualPrompt: traveler with backpack leaving home in the morning, cheerful
